svg.title: How it works
svg.desc: Your sign, an ESP32 board wired to a 3.5-inch screen, joins your home Wi-Fi (2.4 GHz). Once a minute, every 5 minutes overnight, it asks BART's live departures service at api.bart.gov for your station's trains over HTTPS. It draws them in the platform sign's own font and counts the minutes down between updates. The first time, the sign makes its own Wi-Fi network, BART-SIGN-XXXX; join it on your phone, open 192.168.4.1 if the page doesn't appear, and pick your Wi-Fi network, station and line.
svg.text: From BART's data to your desk
An ESP32 and a 3.5" screen. Once a minute it asks
BART for your station's trains over HTTPS (every
5 min overnight), then draws the answer in the
platform sign's font and counts down between updates.
The sign makes its own Wi-Fi, BART-SIGN-XXXX.
Join it on your phone; the setup page opens, or go to 192.168.4.1.
Pick your Wi-Fi network, your station and your line.
The sign restarts, joins your network and starts showing trains.
